pieces.file: Leibniz — rich — two clocks, no wire.m4a
pieces.title: Two clocks, no wire
pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* The first half is Leibniz's pre-established harmony. The second is two Kuramoto phases with rising coupling, which his page does not name: a neighbour leaking in. *Leaking in:* Kuramoto Coupling, in the wired half.
pieces.near: the way two clocks set once keep the same time

pieces.file: Leibniz — rich — two clocks, no wire — picture.svg
pieces.title: Two clocks, no wire · drawn
pieces.caption: First, two clocks set once and never touching: a wooden tock in the left ear, a metal tick in the right. They stay together because each keeps its own time. Then a wired pair: they start apart, plainly at different rates, and as the wire tightens they pull into step. The first pair is exactly together; the wired pair ends within a hundredth of a second. Only the second needed a wire.
pieces.near: the way two clocks set once keep the same time

pieces.file: Leibniz — rich — every jewel reflects every other.png
pieces.title: Every jewel reflects every other
pieces.caption: The picture at the top of Leibniz's page, rebuilt from the avatars of other pages. Step back and it is his; step in and it is everyone else's. *What is real and what is a choice:* 1,848 tiles from 123 of the other 328 pages' avatars, each chosen only for how light or dark it is. Nothing is tinted. *Leaking in:* A third of the palace's pages; Indra's Net is the page's own image.
pieces.near: a jewel at every knot reflecting every other jewel

verdicts.file: Leibniz — rich — two clocks, no wire.m4a

verdicts.file: Leibniz — rich — every jewel reflects every other.png
verdicts.why: The honesty line is false in the humble direction: "The tinting is what makes it read." I rebuilt it with the tint and softening removed and the picture reads as well, and crisper, with every avatar recognisable; the real avatars do all the work and the tint only muddies them. Remake by deleting the tint term and the softening (one line, `make-icon-pieces.py:51`), fix the line, and place it as a band: at 440 px each tile is 6.7 px and "step in and it is everyone else's" cannot happen.
